meaning: 不管你多年轻都没关系
usageNote: 鼓励人的万能句！'It doesn't matter + how/what/where'就是'不管怎样都无所谓'，超正能量语气！

examples.en: It doesn't matter how young you are, you can still make a difference.
examples.zh: 不管你多年轻，你仍然可以改变世界。

examples.en: It doesn't matter how young you are to start chasing your dreams.
examples.zh: 追逐梦想，从来不嫌年轻。
